# The Rocketable Origin Story


### Interview with Bryce Roberts from Indie.vc


[Alan Wells](https://substack.com/@rocketable)


Mar 15, 2025


Last week I sat down with


[Bryce Roberts](https://x.com/bryce) from


[Indie.vc](https://www.indie.vc/) to talk about how Rocketable got started, the superpowers that LLMs give to solo entrepreneurs, and why now is the time to build an AI-powered software holding company.


Spoiler alert: after our interview, Bryce invested! Full interview above (51 mins, also on


[YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=K2TmSVKsmaY) ). Shorter version (12 mins)


[available on X](https://x.com/indievc/status/1899870577256739215) .


Thanks for reading about Rocketable! Subscribe here for updates:
